notes.title: Canto I, full Controller Update!
notes.notes:
Hiya everyone, LudosGD here!

First of all, thanks to everyone who played the game! It means a lot to me and I'm glad so many of you had fun with it.

Canto I 1.1 update is out NOW! It focuses on improving controller support, after collecting various feedback. Here are the changes:

Fullscreen mode support. Fullscreen is now an option in the options menu. It can also be toggled by pressing F2.
Controller support improvement! Fixed various controller-related bugs, such as:

Bug preventing controller users to select voices on menus;
Bug causing issues with movement and jump inputs after using the joystick.
Removed the very unwieldy d-pad and joystick jump input.
Move with d-pad or left joystick.
Jump with Triangle or Cross (Playstation), A or Y (Xbox), B or X (Nintendo).
Attack with Square or Circle (Playstation), X or B (Xbox), A or Y (Nintendo).
Dash with L1 or R1.

I hope these changes will make your next adventure into the Forest Dark more comfortable!

Enjoy, and have a wonderful day! :D
— LudosGD
